title: Label Coverage Bounds Pooled Macro F1: A Reporting Diagnostic for Closed-Set IDS Benchmarks: Reproducibility Artifact
description: Code, fold-count audits, confusion matrices and manuscript sources for a pre-fit label-coverage check. Includes five-seed NSL-KDD pipeline comparisons, a same-prediction fine-label/five-category reanalysis under two scoring conventions, and the full UNSW pair grid. This metadata file does not establish a deposited record or DOI.
